title: x402 failure: the authorization expired (validBefore in the past)
summary: The client signed a window that closed before the server verified it. The facilitator rejects the payload, the handler does not run and the client must sign again.

steps.label: Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
steps.detail: The client reuses a payment it signed earlier, or waited too long. validBefore is already in the past when the request arrives.

steps.label: POST /verify
steps.detail: The server forwards the payload together with its own copy of the requirements.

steps.label: Return isValid false (valid_before)
steps.detail: The facilitator compares validBefore with the current time and refuses the payload. The spec code for this case is invalid_exact_evm_payload_authorization_valid_before.

steps.label: 402 with a fresh PAYMENT-REQUIRED
steps.detail: The server does not run the handler and nothing moves on chain. It returns the requirements again so the client can sign a new authorization. The reference server puts the verify reason, invalid_exact_evm_payload_authorization_valid_before, in the error field of the new PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

steps.label: Sign again with a new window and nonce
steps.detail: The client signs a new authorization with a current window and a new random nonce, then retries. Keeping the window short (maxTimeoutSeconds) limits how long a leaked signature stays usable.
